newsitem.title: JAPAN: Russia to resume Japan PGM exports July 10-traders.
newsitem.headline: Russia to resume Japan PGM exports July 10-traders.

text.p: Russia's platinum group metals (PGM) export agency on Wednesday informed Japanese clients by fax that Russia would resume PGM shipments to Japan around July 10, Japanese precious metals traders said.
"We just received a fax from Almaz (Almazjuvelirexport) saying that the contracted shipments to Japan would resume 'approximately' around July 10," an official of a major bullion house said.
In the fax, Almaz said: "Sorry for further delays. We cannot ship PGM in the first week of July due to some technical problems in the packing procedure," the official said.

Japanese traders had requested that Almaz ship PGM as soon as possible after the pricing was completed on the recently signed term contract, and the first shipments were supposed to arrive today or on Thursday.
Supplies under the term contract are based on average prices in the previous month on NYMEX, the traders said.
